caption:
RECIPE BELOW👇🏽 
If you’re looking for a SUPER easy and delicious midweek meal, then PLEASE try this recipe as it’s INCREDIBLY DELICIOUS!

Enjoy 💚

DB x

Ps my husband DOES cook for me too x

INGREDIENTS 

▪️1 and half courgettes, sliced in half
▪️4 large tomatoes 
▪️5 cloves of garlic 
▪️1 tbsp of tomato puree
▪️Seasoning of your choice: 1 tsp smoked paprika, chilli flakes 
▪️2 large handfuls of spinach, chopped
▪️Salt and pepper

METHOD 

▪️Heat a little oil over medium-high heat. 
▪️Add your courgette, tomatoes and garlic. 
▪️Cook for a few minutes until your aubergine has browned a little. Then lower the heat and cover the pan. 
▪️Cook for 15-20 minutes until your courgette and tomatoes are soft. 
▪️Remove skin of tomatoes (optional) and then mash them. 
▪️Add in tomato puree, spinach and seasoning, stir and cook for a further few minutes. Add cooked pasta and enjoy.
